how_times_were_found: video_start_s / video_end_s: read from 1-frame-per-second contact sheets of each MP4 and cross-checked by matching every scene screenshot (screens/*.png) against the video frames; accuracy about +-1 s. wall_clock_ms: the recorder's own scene log (scenes.json), milliseconds since the recorder started; it differs from video time because the video is assembled from Chrome screencast frames by their own timestamps.
overlay_note: The dark recording-annotation bar (label, scene, full run_id, code identity) is visible in the per-scene screenshots (screens/*.png, 1440x900) but NOT in the video frames: the screencast frames are 1440x814 and cut off the bottom of the viewport where the bar sits (only the last ~3 s of the run-1 video show it). In the videos, the code identity is the product's own status line at the top of every page ('code 7a9aefa+uncommitted(<first 8 of tracked diff sha>)') and the run_id is the page's 'Run ID' field (shortened, e.g. 12591384...440b). The labels below were added in round 31 as a soft subtitle track and chapter titles in a separate *_chapters.mp4 copy; the video stream is copied unchanged (see video_stream_md5).
